purpose: Optimize language-model programs with bounded evaluation and data disclosure.

trigger: Optimize this DSPy RAG program on a fixed dataset
Compare two DSPy teleprompter runs and metrics
Create a DSPy module with a reproducible held-out evaluation
do_not_trigger: Ask a general question about Python classes

preflight: Pin DSPy/provider versions, model ID, data split and evaluation metric.
Confirm whether prompts and examples may be sent to an external model.
Bound token spend and ensure test sets are not reused as training data.
workflow: Define input/output signature and baseline with held-out cases.
Run bounded optimization with approved provider/data-sharing scope.
Evaluate optimized vs baseline with paired examples.
Record artifact, prompt version and costs for reproducibility.

evidence.how_to_verify: Pin program version, dataset split, model and metric.
Owner approves external data transfer and model API budget.
Compare held-out outcome by matching examples with/without optimization.

failure_modes: If dataset confidentiality is unclear, do not send it to external provider.
Never report an in-sample improvement as held-out generalization.
